contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_artists_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `artists` BEGIN DELETE FROM `artists_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_artists_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `artists` BEGIN DELETE FROM `artists_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_artists_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `artists` BEGIN INSERT INTO `artists_fts`(`docid`, `name`, `display_name`, `aliases`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`name`, NEW.`display_name`, NEW.`aliases`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_artists_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `artists` BEGIN INSERT INTO `artists_fts`(`docid`, `name`, `display_name`, `aliases`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`name`, NEW.`display_name`, NEW.`aliases`); END
entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`name` TEXT NOT NULL, `display_name` TEXT NOT NULL, `aliases` TEXT, content=`artists`)
